{"code": "import statsmodels.api as sm

# Create a logistic regression model to assess channel effect on conversion, adjusting for customer_segment
# First, create dummy variables for customer_segment
sales_df_model = sales_df_completed.copy()
sales_df_model = pd.get_dummies(sales_df_model, columns=['customer_segment'], drop_first=True)

# Define the model: conversion as dependent, channel and customer_segment as independent
X = sales_df_model[['channel', 'customer_segment_loyal', 'customer_segment_returning']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)  # Add intercept
y = sales_df_model['converted']

# Fit the logistic regression model
model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary
print(model.summary())"}
